notes: Project Hunt source list. The app reads the public copy at github.com/TheAshikSarker/project-hunt-config and falls back to this bundled file. Only public, documented endpoints are listed; each entry says what was checked.

sources.name: CrowdGen by Appen
sources.notes: Lever public postings API (no key). Lever documents it as public; published postings are publicly viewable. Live Bengali (Bangladesh) transcription postings seen Nov 2026.

sources.name: RWS TrainAI
sources.notes: Lever public postings API. Bengali (Bangladesh) transcription and speech evaluation roles based in Dhaka seen Nov 2026.

sources.name: Welo Data (Welocalize)
sources.notes: Lever public postings API. Bengali roles open to Bangladesh / India seen Nov 2026.

sources.name: Welo Data (Welo Global)
sources.notes: Second Welo Lever board. Bengali translation validation roles seen 2026.

sources.name: Wing Data
sources.notes: Lever public postings API. Multi-locale voice data roles that include Bengali.

sources.name: Alignerr
sources.notes: Greenhouse Job Board API (public, no key). Board lists 'AI Trainer for Bengali Writers/Speakers'.

sources.name: LXT
sources.notes: Recruitee Careers Site API, documented as not needing authorization. Bengali speech rater and transcriber roles seen.

sources.name: DataForce by TransPerfect
sources.notes: Recruitee Careers Site API. Many roles are on-site in India; the filter marks those as location restricted.

sources.name: Remotive (search: Bengali, Bangla)
sources.notes: Remotive public API. Terms: jobs are delayed 24 hours, link back to Remotive, call only a few times a day (2 keywords x 2 per day here).

sources.name: Jobicy (feed search: Bengali)
sources.notes: Jobicy job feed with a keyword. Jobicy allows automated checks at most once an hour and asks for attribution. Feed URL format not yet verified on a device.
